title: Dragon Ball
premise: Ki flows through every living thing. Fighters train to push past their limits. Somewhere out there, the Dragon Balls can grant any wish.

lore.title: Kame House
lore.text: A sea-side island home where Master Roshi trains students in the ways of the Turtle School. Its quiet beach and open water make it a classic training ground, far from the cities where bigger fights are waiting.

lore.title: Namek
lore.text: A green planet home to the Namekians, a peaceful race that can regenerate wounds and fight with extended limbs. The Namekian Dragon Balls originate here, guarded in the village of the elder Guru.

lore.title: Hyperbolic Time Chamber
lore.text: A pocket dimension where time runs far faster than outside. A single day in the real world can equal a full year inside, letting fighters push their training to extremes while the world barely notices.

lore.title: Planet Vegeta
lore.text: The homeworld of the Saiyan race, a harsh planet of brutal warriors. Frieza's forces destroyed it, leaving only scattered survivors across the galaxy, including Vegeta, who was sent off as a child.

lore.title: Saiyan Race
lore.text: A warrior race with tails and power levels that rise through battle and hard training. Saiyans are bred for conquest, and their legendary Super Saiyan transformation is rooted in ancient prophecy.

lore.title: Frieza Force
lore.text: The galactic army of Lord Frieza, who conquers planets and enslaves their populations. Elite commanders like Zarbon and Dodoria lead its soldiers, and the Ginyu Force serves as its strongest squad.

lore.title: Capsule Corp
lore.text: A corporation in West City run by Dr. Brief and his daughter Bulma. It invents capsules that store objects, vehicles, and even whole houses, and builds scouters and the Gravity Room for training.

lore.title: Red Ribbon Army
lore.text: A paramilitary organization with ambitions of world domination through advanced biotechnology. It builds androids and cyborgs to threaten Earth, and its scientists push artificial life to dangerous limits.

lore.title: Dragon Balls
lore.text: Seven orbs that scatter across the world and gather to summon Shenron, the Eternal Dragon. Shenron grants a single wish, then the Balls scatter again, sending fighters on a race to collect them first.

lore.title: Ki
lore.text: The life energy that flows through every living thing. Fighters learn to sense ki signatures, gather it into blasts like the Kamehameha, and raise their power level through training, meditation, and battle.

lore.title: Super Saiyan
lore.text: A legendary Saiyan transformation triggered by overwhelming rage or extreme ki mastery. Golden hair and a blazing aura multiply a fighter's power, and Goku, Vegeta, and Gohan each reach the form.

lore.title: Ultra Instinct
lore.text: A state where the body reacts without conscious thought, moving faster than the mind can plan. Goku masters it through relentless training, letting him dodge attacks that would overwhelm any opponent.

lore.title: World Tournament
lore.text: A massive martial arts competition held on Earth, drawing fighters from across the planet. Winners earn fame and prize money, and the event serves as a proving ground for ambitious warriors and their rivals.

lore.title: Goku
lore.text: A Saiyan raised on Earth after arriving there as an infant. He trains relentlessly, seeks out the strongest opponents, and masters Super Saiyan and Ultra Instinct. Cheerful, simple, and driven by battle.

lore.title: Vegeta
lore.text: The proud Saiyan prince, once a ruthless enforcer for Frieza. He trains in the Gravity Room and the Hyperbolic Time Chamber to match Goku's strength, and fights to prove himself the superior warrior.

lore.title: Frieza
lore.text: The tyrant lord of the Frieza Force and a relentless galactic conqueror. Frieza destroyed Planet Vegeta and countless worlds, ruling through fear, and has transformed several times to reclaim his power.

lore.title: Piccolo
lore.text: A Namekian warrior who was once the Demon King, now a protector of Earth. He trained Gohan in tactics and discipline, and he uses his regenerative body and sharp mind to fight alongside Goku.

lore.title: Gohan
lore.text: Goku's eldest son, raised with a gentle nature and a huge power level inherited from his Saiyan blood. Trained by Piccolo, he grows into one of Earth's strongest fighters, though he often hides his potential.

lore.title: Master Roshi
lore.text: A legendary martial artist who runs Kame House and founded the Turtle School. Known for his lechery and his mastery of the Kamehameha, he trains young fighters and tests their discipline with odd methods.

lore.title: Bulma
lore.text: Daughter of Dr. Brief and head of Capsule Corp. A brilliant inventor who builds the Dragon Radar, scouters, and the Gravity Room, she supplies the technology that keeps Earth's fighters in the race.

lore.title: Dr. Gero
lore.text: A scientist of the Red Ribbon Army who designs androids and cyborgs. Obsessed with perfecting artificial life, he creates Androids 17 and 18 and drives them toward revenge against Goku.
